log_file.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to stdout (for systemd journal)

auto_restart.description: Automatically restart opensm if it crashes (useful for high-availability)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of restart attempts before giving up

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait before attempting a restart

primary_port_guid.description: Port GUID to use for SM operations (0 = auto-select first IB port)

priority.description: SM priority (1–15). Lower values have higher priority in master election

default_priority.description: Priority assigned to backup SMs in a high-availability pair

sm_mode.description: Mode of operation: 'master' (primary SM), 'backup' (standby), or 'standalone' (no peer)

split_mode.description: Enable split-mode for fabrics with physically separate subnets on dual-ported cards

num_threads.description: Number of threads to handle MADs — higher improves throughput on large fabrics

max_mads.description: Maximum number of outstanding MAD requests (higher = more concurrent operations)

mad_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for MAD responses before considering a request failed

qos.description: Enable QoS support (required if QoS policies are configured in fabric)

sl2vl.description: Enable SL to VL mapping (required for SL-to-VL reassignment)

gid_table.description: Enable GID table management (required for IPv6 over InfiniBand)

pkey_table.description: Enable PKey table management (required for partition key support)

excluded_ports.description: List of port GUIDs or numbers to exclude from SM management

included_ports.description: List of ports to include when IncludePortsOnly is true

include_ports_only.description: If true, only ports listed in IncludedPort will be managed

database_file.description: Path to persistent state database for SM failover/restart

database_persist.description: Persist SM state (LIDs, PKeys, GIDs) across restarts

ports.description: List of port GUIDs (in hex) or special value 'ALL'/'NONE' to control which ports opensm starts on
